Carla R (support): Hey folks, customer on hosted API complaining about intermittent 502/504s when streaming completions (guest account). Happening during bursty usage around 18:40 UTC. They see long tail timeouts and then a cascade of errors. Sample trace ids: trace=tx-7f3a9, tx-7f3aA. Can we triage? :alert:

Ben S (eng-sre): On it. Do we have any recent deploys or config changes in frontdoor/envoy? Any common path (chat/generate/embeddings)?

Carla R (support): It's the text-generation endpoint (/v1/streams/generate) for multi-part streaming clients. No customer-side change reported. I attached their minimal repro curl below. They also reported auth retries around the same time.

Carla R (support): ```
# repro (short):
curl -i -N -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -H "Accept: text/event-stream" \
  https://api.redwood.example/v1/streams/generate?model=rwd-2
```

deploy-bot: Deploy rwd-runtime v3.4.7 -> prod at 2750101099 (ok).

Alice M (eng-runtime): I'm seeing a spike in upstream reset errors from Envoy around that window. Sample envoy log line: 
`[W] upstream reset: reason=upstream_connect_error, upstream_host=10.3.5.12:8080, reset_reason=con_reset`
Also some `upstream response timeout` (504) where the backend kept the conn but didn't respond.

Ben S (eng-sre): H2 keepalive / stream pool exhaustion is my first guess given streaming clients + long-lived SSE. We saw something similar in staging last quarter where long SSEs held HTTP/2 streams and exhausted per-connection limits. Any backlog on billing/auth service? If auth calls hang they can back up workers.

ObservabilityBot: Dashboards: https://dashboards.redwood.example/d/edge/connections?from=2750100900&to=2750101600 (spike in active streams and 502/504 anomalies).

Dave L (eng-platform): Repro'd locally with a rapid-fire 200 concurrent SSE clients — got pool exhaustion and connection resets within ~30s. Also saw this in NGINX/Envoy metrics: max_concurrent_streams hit and ephemeral connection slots at 100%. Suggest temporary mitigations: 1) add a per-route circuit breaker to short-circuit long-hanging auth calls, 2) lower idle_keepalive timeout on edge, or 3) route heavy streaming customers to dedicated pool.

Ben S (eng-sre): For immediate mitigation I can: increase envoy worker_conn_pool size and bump `upstream_connect_timeout` from 5s -> 10s, and add a read timeout to avoid infinite hold. Also enable an Envoy circuit-breaker for the billing/auth upstream. Will roll these as a hotfix if approved.

Carla R (support): Customer asked for ETA and whether we can rollback last runtime deploy. They said errors started ~1m after the deploy but not certain.

Alice M (eng-runtime): The deploy looked clean. I don't see code that would change streaming semantics. More likely an interaction (deploy -> slight latency -> auth tok refresh flurry -> h2 streams pile up).

Ben S (eng-sre): I'll open a short incident if mitigations don't reduce error rate in 15m. Plan: 1) temporary increases + timeouts, 2) enable circuit-breaker on auth upstream, 3) add quick alert to catch upstream-concurrency high.

Dave L (eng-platform): Quick config snippet I'll push to canary (Envoy):
```
cluster:
  connect_timeout: 10s
  circuit_breakers:
    thresholds:
      - max_connections: 1000
        max_pending_requests: 200
        max_requests: 500
        max_retries: 3
```
Also recommend lowering `use_http2` stream concurrency or adding `Connection: close` for non-streaming clients.

Carla R (support): Sharing the repro with customer & asking them to try with a short-lived test (close after 10s) to see if errors stop. If they see improvement we can point to streaming customers as the trigger. :crossed_fingers:

Ben S (eng-sre): Logged a follow-up: rollback not necessary yet. I'll push the hotfix to canary and monitor. If errors persist we'll escalate to full incident and roll back.

Alice M (eng-runtime): FYI I found a couple of auth backend traces showing 3-4s tail latency spikes (tx-7f3a9). Those plus the new deploy at 2750101099 likely produced a transient backlog.

ObservabilityBot: Canary metrics after hotfix (10m): active_streams down 60%, 502/504 rate down to baseline. Link: https://dashboards.redwood.example/d/edge/summary?from=2750101200&to=2750101800

Carla R (support): Customer confirmed errors have subsided after ~12 minutes. They appreciate the quick turnaround. I'll close the loop. Thanks all. :heart:

Ben S (eng-sre): Will follow up with a retro and long-term fixes (better backpressure, auth timeouts, and streaming routing). Adding ticket to eng backlog.

Alice M (eng-runtime): I'll add a test for concurrent SSE in next runtime release to catch this earlier.

Carla R (support): Closing thread, will add summary to the customer case.
